comments.text: Such an innovative era. Developers threw everything at this machine like it had no limits, so many great ideas even if the hardware wasn't ready for them all yet. They were setting new industry standards and pioneering new genres left and right. There was a level of ambition and inventiveness that has been missing from major developers for a while now that so much money is involved. That creativity has shifted to indie developers with all the accessible tools available these days which is nice, but it is rarely combined with scale hitting the limits of the hardware like it was in this era.
